issues.title: CPU sky-sample port broken by scratch aliasing: world.weather.skyLight ~0 by day, brighter at night; fog.color black
issues.detail: atmosphere.js skyRadiance() line 135 passes its scratch vector _q into opticalDepth(), which reuses _q (line 103) and clobbers the shared _d density (line 104); lines 137-140 then integrate with the wrong density. Noon skyLight = (1e-5,1e-5,2e-5), midnight = (0.0034,0.0044,0.0086); scene.fog.color at noon = #0d0b0c. Consumers: published skyLight (contract field), rain colour, uCloudAmb. Fix: separate scratch buffers for opticalDepth (or pass copies) and assert noon zenith > night floor.

issues.title: Noon frames washed out and flat (p1 >= 43/255, shadows only ~30% darker than lit ground, sat 0.19-0.34)
issues.detail: Partly preset fogDensity 0.00034 gives ~16% haze at 520 m and ~26% at 900 m; environmentIntensity 0.8 from a full-sky PMREM plus sun 5.14 at exposure 1.25 puts ambient too close to direct; showcase ground albedo (envTint*1.35) far above real grass. Fix: clear/partly fog 0.00008-0.00012, environmentIntensity ~0.45 at noon ramping up at dusk, ground albedo <= 0.35, target ~3:1 lit:shadow on the ground at noon.

issues.title: Showcase ground tiles visibly as a regular 13 m lattice in every aerial/skyline frame (moire streaks at grazing angles)
issues.detail: aerial_grass_rock repeats every 13 m over 8 km; mix(envT1,envT2,0.3) at 0.23 scale and a 2.2 km macro tint do not break the lattice. Fix: per-cell random rotation/offset texture bombing (hex or 2-tap stochastic), 30-200 m macro noise, drop the 1.35 multiplier, add a second dirt detail texture blended by noise.

issues.title: Golden hour and sunset are sepia monochrome and under-exposed (sunset_17p9 p50 = 26, half the frame < 10%; aerial_6p5 p99 = 105)
issues.detail: Exposure curve adds only +0.25 at low sun while transmittance and the PMREM ambient are both Mie-orange, so shadows go brown instead of CS2's cool blue. Fix: exposure ~1.9-2.2 when sun elevation < 12 deg; keep ambient blue (real skyLight after fix #1, or PMREM from a sun-masked LUT / separate hemisphere term).

issues.title: Cloud layer reads as a flat 2D noise sheet with no volume; clouds stay crisp above a fog white-out
issues.detail: Single 1500 m shell with one lit/occluded factor, stratus smear toward the horizon, no vertical lighting gradient, no fog attenuation. Fix: 4-8 step raymarch through a 300-600 m slab (or two offset shells with height-based darkening), Beer-Powder lighting, fade clouds by the same height-fog transmittance used for terrain.

issues.title: Fog preset shows a hard horizon seam: dome band (mid-grey, crisp clouds) does not match the fogged ground (light grey)
issues.detail: Ground fog samples the LUT in the view direction, but the dome draws clouds/haze on top of the LUT and receives no in-scatter fog. Fix: apply the same envFog extinction/in-scatter to the dome below ~5 deg elevation scaled by fogDensity, or blend the dome toward the fog colour with 1-exp(-fogDensity*k).

issues.title: Dry grass turns glossy with corduroy specular streaks at grazing sun
issues.detail: normalScale 1.5 plus ARM roughness at grazing GGX angles gives a wet sheen with wetness 0. Fix: floor roughness ~0.85 for dry grass, normalScale <= 0.8, or a Fresnel horizon fade on the ground.

issues.title: Night ground tint is olive-green instead of CS2's desaturated blue-grey
issues.detail: Exposure 3.0 on green albedo dominates the blue moon tint. Fix: desaturate diffuse by night (~0.5), night exposure ~2.2, cooler MOON_TINT.

issues.title: Stars are uniform 5-6 px soft blobs (reads like snow); milky way invisible
issues.detail: Fix: radius <= 1.5 px at 1080p, size and brightness from magnitude with more variance; make the band faintly visible.

issues.title: Night window emissive clips to flat white; distant facades shimmer
issues.detail: uWinNight = night*0.55 at exposure 3.0 saturates AgX and loses the warm/cool tints; 3 m window grid aliases on far towers. Fix: emissive ~0.25, fade the grid by mip level/distance.

issues.title: Rain barely visible; streak colour depends on the broken skyLight
issues.detail: 9000 thin streaks in a 140 m box read as a few grey scratches at 1080p; rain.js uColor = skyLight*2.2+0.02 is ~0.02 grey while issue 1 stands. Fix: wider/longer streaks with distance-based width, more density near the camera, colour from the LUT zenith.

issues.title: Triangles (111,554; 129,554 with rain) exceed the module's own declared budget of 60,000
issues.detail: SphereGeometry(3.2,48,32) x 9 and a 48x32 dome. Fix: 32x16 spheres and dome, or declare the budget honestly.

issues.title: Lighting.sweep() traverses the entire scene every frame
issues.detail: lighting.js 52-57; fine for 40 objects, will eat the 2 ms per-module budget in democity. Fix: hook materials on section change events / module:ready instead of per-frame traversal.

issues.title: Every night is a full moon, visible by day opposite the sun
issues.detail: moonDir = sun + 12.35 h. Fix: offset by a day-of-month phase; cosmetic.

strengths: Physically based single-scattering sky LUT (Rayleigh/Mie/ozone) feeding PMREM: sky colour, sun aureole and 17:30 horizon haze are right; IBL on the sphere ladder matches the sky
Correct sun path east->south->west computed locally and published; core sunAzimuth bug documented in docs/core-requests/environment.md rather than worked around silently
CSM 3x2048 PCF with fade and camera-adaptive maxFar: soft, correctly placed contact shadows at all times; sun->moon switch keeps shadows at night
Per-window random warm/cool night lights with reveals on the showcase towers; the night frames are the most CS2-like output
Weather: five presets, ?weather honoured at boot, setWeather with clamping and weather:changed events, wetness dynamics, sun-projected cloud shadows, GPU-only rain in one draw

Hygiene: only this module adds lights or touches renderer state; 10 draws vs 15 budget; 0.3 ms update; zero errors and zero NaNs across the clock; deterministic; rng-only randomness; CC0 assets in the manifest
summary: Score 6.0, FAIL. Sky/atmosphere plumbing, CSM shadows and night window lights are solid, but every noon frame is washed out (p1 >= 43, ~30% shadow contrast), golden hour and sunset are sepia-dark, the showcase ground shows a glaring 13 m tile lattice, the fog preset has a horizon seam, and world.weather.skyLight is garbage (night brighter than day) because of scratch-buffer aliasing in atmosphere.js. 0 console errors, ready in all 28 shots, max 11 draws of 15; API contract fails on skyLight and 'noon crisp'.
